title: ARCH-2 pre-registration amendment 1 (owner-requested P0 fixes), committed before any ARCH-2 experiment
amends: experiments/ARCH2/arch2_preregistration.json @ ad78e1dd5fa71be83d156e0c3482d6304ab7b3c7 (kept unchanged; this file takes precedence where they differ)
status: ARCH2_PREREG_READY (amended) - no ARCH-2 experiment has been run

P0_1_no_exposed_algorithm_selection.replaces: gate2_discrimination.stop_or_degrade and overall_success of the original
P0_1_no_exposed_algorithm_selection.rule: Whether PROTECT_SOFT is enabled is decided ONLY on the 10 training sheets by the selection rule and frozen in experiments/ARCH2/arch2_freeze.json before any exposed run. On 13014 / 15076 Gate 2 only grades PASS / FAIL; it never disables, enables or switches V3. If Gate 2 fails on exposed, the frozen V3 still runs (for failure attribution) and the overall ARCH-2 result is FAIL.
P0_1_no_exposed_algorithm_selection.overall_success: PASS only if Gates 1, 2, 3 and 4 all pass on the exposed sheets with the frozen configuration; no weaker 'protection disabled' pass exists

P0_2_gate1_thresholds.training_per_sheet: training sheets hold 0-9 instances of 3-6 px each; per-sheet values are reported but judged only pooled
P0_2_gate1_thresholds.stop: if any condition fails, STOP after Gate 1: no threshold selection, no Gate 2-4 algorithm runs

P0_3_discrimination_and_metrics.missing_colour: s_colour is computed from centre-line pixels (+-1 px) not on ink (1 px dilated black-hat ink). If fewer than 5 such pixels on the candidate, or fewer than 5 non-ink pixels in the 3-px ring of either neighbour side, s_colour is MISSING; a candidate with any MISSING feature is UNCERTAIN (never PROTECT_SOFT, never MERGE); missing is never treated as 0
selection_constraints_training: ADDED by the agent: overall FDR of protected candidates (INK_BAND + INCIDENTAL) <= 0.50
P0_3_discrimination_and_metrics.gate2_pass_exposed: on EACH exposed sheet AND pooled: ink-band false protection <= 0.30, overall FDR <= 0.50, protected TRUE_NARROW recall >= 0.30 (point estimates)
report_separately: classification: precision / recall / FPR / FDR, false protection by INK_BAND and by INCIDENTAL, base rates
P0_3_discrimination_and_metrics.per_sheet: 13014 and 15076 are always reported and judged separately; a pooled value never overrides a failing sheet
P0_3_discrimination_and_metrics.uncertainty_note: Wilson intervals and paired bootstrap treat instances as independent; instances within a map are spatially correlated and only two exposed sheets exist, so intervals understate the true uncertainty and no claim about other GSJ map styles is made

V2_definition_fix: original text said 'soft protection on ALL non-MERGE candidates (no discrimination)', which uses MERGE from discrimination; corrected: V2 = soft protection on ALL candidates, no discrimination at all
gate3_pass_per_sheet: Gate 3 conditions apply on the training pool AND on each exposed sheet separately; the paired-bootstrap lower bound > 0 is required for exposed pooled and reported per sheet
